title: A work order line keeps its inactive part and can still be edited
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), a role that has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Create & Edit' and 'Delete'.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-KEEPLINE-01) is tracked at {Location-A}, has Sell Price $20.00 and 4 in its default bin.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} (for example S2-15440) is open and its approved line {Line-1} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST PL KEEPLINE line") holds {Part-A} with quantity 2, added while {Part-A} was active.
  • {Part-A} was set inactive after it was added to {Line-1}.
custom_steps:
1. Open {Work-order-1} and read the {Part-A} row on {Line-1}.
  2. Open the {Part-A} row, change Quantity from 2 to 3 and save.
  3. Open the row again, change Sell Price to $22.00 and save.
  4. Open the row again, add the note "ZZAUTOTEST still here" and save.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: The row is still on {Line-1}: quantity 2, $20.00, total $40.00 (2 × $20.00).
  • Step 2: The change saves and the row total reads $60.00 (3 × $20.00).
  • Step 3: The change saves and the row total reads $66.00 (3 × $22.00); the line total includes it.
  • Step 4: The note saves and the row still holds {Part-A}.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S9-E1, S9-E2, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas 13 Oct copy: no board shows an existing line edit. Tech plan "Parts Lifecycle Update — Technical Implementation Plan", 7 Oct 2026 (informs, never overrules), §5 Modified endpoints. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-E1: “A line that already holds a part when the part becomes inactive stays on its work order, estimate or part sale, including a completed part sale, and its totals keep calculating.”
  • S9-E2: “The user can still change the quantity, price and notes on that line, and save it again with the same part or number.”
  • Tech plan (Parts Lifecycle Update, 7 Oct 2026), §5 Modified endpoints: “Not refused: re-saving the same part (S9-E2), ordering an existing part request (S9-E6), pick, receive, split, invoice”
